## Farming

## Server Events

### New Events
- Vaults: Guess the code to win the prize!
- Raffle Royale: 50% of people enter will win, 50% will lose. Winners get the losers' bets + their own back.

### Existing events
- Rumble Royale
  - Winners now get their fight banner shown upon winning
- Bankrobs
  - Bankrobs are re-vamped to match the original bankrob vision from pre-2022 where it would gradually update with results for people
  - Payouts vary slightly, instead of being exactly the same, to add more randomness
  - Bankrobs can now be canceled by the event manager who started them, before it begins
  - Bankrobs can now be scheduled in advance with an optional argument
- Split or steal
  - Supports a role argument, so the event manager can have the bot assign a role to the people picked
    - This is for the servers who do this manually, so split or steal contestants can chat with each other
  - Split or steal can now be canceled before it starts by the event manager who started it
  - Time to join is now customizable with a command argument
  - Big UI overhaul
- Giveaway
  - Optional role argument when starting a giveaway, where anyone with that role gets 2x the chance towards winning
  - Can use custom messages along with the giveaway, a great place to give quotes from the giveaway donor etc
  - Time argument on this has been GREATLY improved, way more flexible for you
  - Will edit periodically to show how many people have joined
- Raffles
  - Can use custom messages along with the giveaway, a great place to give quotes from the raffle donor etc
  - Will edit periodically to show how many people have joined
  - The entries has been greatly improved, so it's similar more now to like... lottery tickets. Buy x entries for x cost per entry.
- Payouts
  - You can now attach custom messages to payouts

## Server Donations/Logs/Management/QoL
- Serverevent logs are MUCH more detailed than before. (Only for new events after this update!)
- Serverevent donation logs show sources better
  - Additionally when checking a specific user's donations, it gives a summary at the top for you
  - When bankrob fines or raffles happen, it will consolidate the event's "donations" under a single line in the log so you know where it all came from
- You can now set a max # of /serverevent payouts per user per day in the dashboard
- POCKET BASED FUNDING
  - Now, as someone running an event, if the server pool doesn't have what you need to cover the event, the bot will ask if you want to donate the remainder yourself.
    - This will log as a donation from you, if you do so.
- When selecting items during event runs, it will filter to show you what's in the pool + your own pocket
- Generally any time arguments for server events have been made way less restrictive, so you have much more flexibility with timing/scheduling your events
- Generally, serve revents as a whole now has better logging and backend protection. There should be little to no possibility for perm lost coins from errors etc.

## NOTE:
- This serverevent update has been tested for a long period of time, but at scale, new issues can arise. Please just report them accordingly if something breaks, and we'll fix it soon.

## Session
- /session is now available for everyone
- This is the major session tracking feature we announced previously. Rollout was at 25% of users, and is now at 100% of users.

## Session Tracking
- We have started a small rollout of a new feature to track some data while grinding for you to review.
- To start, it will be available to premium users and a random selection of 25% of the playerbase.
  - We will roll it out to more once we're sure it's ready to go!

### Fishing Session
- Track nearly all fishing data while fishing. Lots of data to view!

### Gambling Session
- It's like your gambling stats in /profile, but for a certain time period!

### XP Grinding Session
- Displays the number of individual rewards per type FROM levels, not all commands while leveling
- Displays lots of grinding info (levels, xp, prestiges, etc)
- In the future once we change some backend tech, we'll have more detailed reward tracking, similar to fishing sessions!

### How do sessions work?
- You can have 5 sessions active at any given time
- If you **delete** a session, the data is gone! To stop collecting data and just view the session stats, simply pause the session.
- Sessions will track any data (for the type of session) from any time when it's running. You can pause and resume if needed!
- You can, if you choose, have multiple sessions of the same type running. For instance if you're tracking a week of fishing, but really want to see how many bosses you can get today, just start a second session!

- Added a new gambling command: Coin Toss!
- Coin Toss
	- Flip a coin. If you pick the right side, your bet is doubled. If you pick the wrong side, you lose your bet.
	- There is a TINY TINY TINY TINY ULTRA RARE chance that the coin will land on its side, and you will get 2.5x payout instead of 2x. This is not "the point" of the game, it's just enough to give you an advantage to profit more often than not long term IF you're lucky.
	- There are streaks for how many in a row you get right, this is JUST for fun and doesn't matter!
	  - There is a coin toss streak leaderboard in /leaderboard stats (active streak, not all time best!)
	  - You can show your all time best streak in your gambling stats in the profile editor!
	- This was not a planned new feature, but just a quick passion project. Because of that, there is no art (coin showing heads or tails, or badge) but we will add art (and a badge!) in the future!

## Luck
- Further tweaked luck calculation (slightly more luck)

**Why change luck??**
When luck was built, it was intended to be a more rare, smaller value, reward. These days, it's becoming more common as a reward, and is easily acquired in multiple ways by nearly any player.

The issue is, our luck system was not working as intended. Specifically, giving the most luck to the rarest 1-2 loot table items to the point of often making them the most common chances in the loot table. This has wreaked havoc on game balance for players at all levels, furthering both inflation and player expectations for their constant rewards.

The new formula for luck, while still a WIP, correctly increases odds for all but 1-2 of the most common items, taking chance away from those 1-2 most common items. The rarest option will no longer become the most common option or surpass the options above it.

While surely this is a big change for grinders, it will allow us to continue making content that applies the luck bonus rather than needing to restrict it (eg, to things such as postmemes in the future).

And despite it being a big difference, the bonus luck can give is still statistically **incredible** even at low luck values. [Here is an image showing the odds of the rarest outcome in tidy with various luck values on this update's existing luck system](https://imagedelivery.net/BLWzKjZx6tWuG7fpo67USA/9bcc4716-df71-4754-701b-b959254b8800/public)

  - It now prevents all above things to start "counting"/breaking in the first place (not just daily, it is like vacation in an active item)

title: Bot Update 2022.37.1
content:
### Work Overhaul
-  Energy drink now has a use; check it out with the `/item` command
-  The fewer shifts a job requires daily, the more often you can run the shift. No longer just an hour for all jobs. You can view the times in `/work list`.
-  Added work stars
    - You will gain a work star every time you get max promotions at a job
    - Each star increases work item drop chance at the given job
    - Added `/work stars` command
    - To get another star in the same job, you have to resign and re-apply
- Improved work embeds to be more user-friendly and less ugly
- Across all jobs total, we added 100 new phrases and 136 new words (most jobs got a couple of new words and a couple of new phrases)
- Most jobs received a pay bump of a few thousand coins

### Market Changes
-  Added partial acceptance to market offers
    - it needs to be enabled by the author when posting the offer, with the required `allow_partial` argument. Setting this to false will result in someone needing to fulfill the entire offer.
    -  Use `/market accept id:x quantity:x` to accept an offer partially [tutorial](https://dankmemer.lol/tutorial/partials)
    - To accept the entire offer in one click still, you can use the buttons in the `/market view` subcommand.
- Added value per unit and fee paid to market logs in DMC for better transparency
- Added a "post again" button to expired market offer notifications
- The "mine" market scope is now a filter in the dropdown, not a command argument
- You can no longer post market offers with an item that is not obtainable yet

### Misc Changes

- Added a revolver use; it is a chat-based mini-game like coin bombs
- Friday is now counted as a weekend (double XP)
- Added a "Refresh Button" upgrade, which impacts most of the paginated menus (where it matters)
- Added a "Net Worth Sort" upgrade, changes sorting of your inventory to be net worth based
    - Once bought, this currently cannot be toggled off. We will add this in the future.
- Added embed colors to blackjack (color depends on winning/losing)
- Added /serverevents payout command
    - Using this for unprotected trading will result in the SERVER being banned from the bot.
- Embed color is now picked randomly from all your active items, not just the last one
- Changed "weeklyrewards" to "Patreon rewards" in the currency log
- Level, experience & experience bar are now separate modules in profile customization
- Added a confirmation when entering raffles
- Added a confirmation when finding someone's pet
- Added ability to customize profile embed color in profile customization (for donors only) 
- Added ability to customize profile embed image in profile customization (for donors only)
- Changed art of 9 badges to make them more consistent with newer badges
- Added content preview to the notification list
- Added Successful Market Offers leaderboard

### EDIT (3 hours post launch)

- Anyone who is at 20 promotions prior to this update needs to just resign to get a work star, we cannot give them automatically
- Added the ability to filter market posts by partial fulfillment
- Added the ability to partially accept things by button on market view (will do max)
